hypotheses.N0_structured_beats_uniform: The best structured attention triple exceeds the best of 84 uniform random 16-mode programs by at least 0.05 median fidelity or 0.10 at the 10th percentile on both corpora.
hypotheses.N1_structured_beats_fisher_weighted: It exceeds a full-Fisher-diagonal-weighted random bank by at least 0.02 median or 0.05 at the 10th percentile on both corpora.
hypotheses.N2_effect_collision_explains_atlas: The weighted random bank is within 0.01 median and 0.05 at the 10th percentile of the structured best on both corpora.
hypotheses.N3_uniform_collision_explains_atlas: Even the uniform random bank is within those tolerances on both corpora.
